assertions.statement: An operator can issue and revoke an order-bound customer return link.
A customer can submit return logistics, assigned device serials, required photos, and optional packaging photos through the public link.
Files are stored in private RustFS through the existing infra_file boundary and cannot be attached across registrations or tenants.
A valid submission creates or reuses one RETURN delivery without changing device, order, inspection, or schedule lifecycle state.
The admin can page, inspect, and review return registrations with permission and tenant isolation.
An authorized administrator can edit only mutable device metadata while immutable identity and lifecycle fields remain server-controlled.
An authorized administrator can logically delete only an available device with no source or business-history references, with permission-controlled UI and server-side confirmation rules.
